name: Wikimedia Commons CC/PD video pool (ORVEX selection)
classification: real-world media downloaded and verified (selected subset)
reason: Only surveyed source with real media bytes whose per-file licence permits storage, transformation and redistribution with attribution; used as source pool for controlled variants.

name: ANAKIN: manipulated videos and mask annotations (incl. VideoSham edited videos)
classification: real-world media downloaded and verified (selected subset)
reason: Only open set with real source->edited video pairs and edit types. Stratified subset of trimmed+edited(+masks) downloaded; 'full' videos (44.6 GB) excluded_over_budget. Used for native edit relations/

name: InVID Fake Video Corpus 2018 (v3)
reason: Real-world repost cascades with fake/real labels; media bytes are not provided (authors do not own rights) so records stay metadata_only; no third-party downloader used.

name: InVID Fake Video Corpus v2.0
reason: Adds native fields not in 2018 CSV (type of manipulation, debunk URLs, tamper timestamp); overlapping records are mapped, not double counted.

name: InVID Fake Video Corpus v1.0
reason: Earlier version (59 entries) superseded by later versions; records kept in media master only to map duplicates (not counted twice).

name: InVID FIVR-200K (Fine-grained Incident Video Retrieval)
reason: Native related-scene vs copy labels (needed to separate same-event from derivation); 225,960 YouTube ids + 100 query annotations. Media bytes not provided.

name: VCSL (Video Copy Segment Localization)
reason: Best real segment-level copy annotations; media rights not cleared, dataset licence not stated, so only annotations and URLs are used; no third-party downloader used.

name: VCDB (Video Copy Detection Benchmark)
reason: Official Fudan page failed TLS certificate validation (not bypassed); the suggested GitHub lead (ccny-zhangx/VCDB) returned 404 on 2026-10-26.

name: A corpus of debunked and verified user-generated videos (journal paper record)
reason: Describes the same corpus as RW-03; contains only the article PDF (380 videos, 5,195 near-duplicates).

name: WildDeepfake
reason: Optional authenticity benchmark only; terms and provenance not verified; must not substitute for a lineage dataset.

name: DFDC (DeepFake Detection Challenge) dataset
reason: Research-generated manipulation dataset; excluded from the naturally-circulating collection per project rule.

name: FaceForensics++
reason: Research-created fakes; not naturally circulating.

name: Celeb-DF / Celeb-DF++
reason: Research-created deepfakes.

name: FakeAVCeleb
reason: Contains AI-generated audio/video; violates the no-synthetic-audio rule.

name: AV-Deepfake1M
reason: Synthetic content.

name: Deepfake-Eval-2024
reason: Authenticity benchmark, optional; access not verified.

name: VSC 2022/2023 Video Similarity Challenge dataset
reason: Terms/access not verified; audio removed so unusable for audio evidence.

name: YFCC100M (video subset)
reason: Requires a signed Webscope agreement; current distribution route not verified.

name: CC_WEB_VIDEO
reason: Official page not reached.

name: SVD (Short Video Dataset)
reason: Terms/access not verified.

name: NIST Nimble / Media Forensics Challenge data
reason: Registration route not verified; mostly images.

name: Twitter/X Information Operations archive
reason: Needs institutional application; current availability unverified. Campaign table left empty.

name: Pushshift Telegram dataset
reason: Availability and terms not verified.

name: TikTok Research API (2024 US election videos, Luceri et al.)
reason: Requires institutional API approval.

name: VideoSham
reason: Its 352 edited videos are already part of ANAKIN (RW-02).

name: HMDB51
reason: Underlying movie footage rights not cleared; no relationship labels.

name: UCF101
reason: Licence unresolved; no relationship labels.

name: Kinetics
reason: Licence conflict; links only; no relationship labels.

name: NewsCLIPpings
reason: Images, with algorithmically constructed mismatches; not video lineage.

name: Datasets for coordinated behaviour (Pacheco 2021, Nizzoli 2021, Indiana coordinated-reply datasheet)
reason: Not verified; Twitter-era data; no video lineage.

reason: Real post-level spread evidence (257k Twitter post ids, 81k Facebook post ids, platform removal times) for the source/post timeline; sharer accounts are NOT provided, so it cannot support coordination
